## Greater Blood Elemental (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
N Huge outsider (elemental, extraplanar, sanguine)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** bloodsense, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +14  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +9 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 208 (13d10+78)  
**Fort** +13; **Ref** +13; **Will** +6  
**DR** 10/–; Immune elemental traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., swim 60 ft (only in bodies of blood such as rivers of blood, lakes of blood, etc.)  
**Melee** 2 slams +21 (2d8+8 plus bleed)  
**Ranged** blood missile +16/+11 (2d6+8/x3, 70 feet, drains the blood elemental of 3 HP per attack)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** bleed (2d4), blood drain (2d4 Con), drench, engulf (DC 24, blood drain)  


**Statistics**


**STR** 26, **Dex** 20, **Con** 21, **Int** 8, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 11  
**BAB** +13; **CMB** +23 (+27 bull rush and grapple); **CMD** 38 (42 vs. bull rush and grapple)  
**Feats** Cleave, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Great Cleave, [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Iron Will, [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Improved Bull Rush, Improved Grapple are covered by Powerful Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative, Toughness.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +20 (+16 if jumping), Escape Artist +20, Knowledge (planes) +12, Perception +14, Stealth +10 (+18 in bodies of blood), Swim +29 (in blood only); Racial Modifiers +8 on Stealth in bodies of blood  
**SQ** blood gourmand, bloody arsenalist  


**Special Abilities**


**Blood Gourmand (Ex)** Upon successfully incurring Constitution damage via their blood drain ability, a blood elemental experiences a temporary empowerment in their physical capabilities. This provides the blood elemental with a +1 bonus on attack rolls and Reflex saves, +1 dodge bonus to AC, and fast healing 1. In addition, their movement speeds increase by 5 feet.
